test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word that can be used here based on the given context.

Macaulay _________ the western education system in India.
solution:
The correct answer is: **introduced**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"introduced" **means to bring something into use or operation for the first time. (परिचय कराना).

 
 
• **Example:** Alexander Fleming introduced the world to penicillin.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that Macaulay played a significant role in introducing the Western education system in India during British rule.

Therefore, the correct answer is-*** introduced***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Improvising** (अनुकूलन कर रहा है) means to create or perform something spontaneously or without preparation.
 
• **Accepting** (स्वीकार कर रहा है) refers to consenting to receive or undertake something offered.
 
• **Revisiting** (पुन: देखना) involves considering or examining something again or from a new perspective.
